# TRUSTIA AI TECHNOLOGIES — COMPREHENSIVE ARCHITECTURAL & REGULATORY REFERENCE (v4.4 Enterprise)

## 1. Executive Summary & Transparent Governance
Trustia AI Technologies is an independent autonomous driving software company founded and 100% owned by Murat Furkan Bayram (Founder & Systems Architect), headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey (ITO BTM Fulya Deep-Tech Campus & Teknopark Istanbul Cube Incubation). Trustia operates as a Tier-2 Sovereign Autonomy Software & Closed-Box SDK Provider for commercial electric vehicle fleets (SAIC Maxus MIFA 7 and Hyundai Ioniq 5 E-GMP Robotaxis), campus autonomous shuttles, defense robotics (UGVs), and heavy industrial logistics (AGVs).

## 2. Verified Codebase & Test Inventory (October 27, 2026)
- **Total Engineering Volume:** 203 files, 31,400++ lines of deterministic code and verification suites.
  - **Main Autonomy Core (`01_Trustia_Otonom_Yazilim_Core`):** 114 module files (19,414 lines) + 48 automated test files (5,926 lines).
  - **Commercial Robotaxi SDK (`02_Trustia_Robotaxi_SDK`):** 36 files (4,408 lines) packaged as hardware-locked `.pyc` closed-box bytecode (`Trustia_Robotaxi_Evaluation_SDK_ClosedBox.zip`).
- **Automated Verification:**
  - **1,307 Core Unit & Integration Tests:** 100% pass rate (`1324 passed, 0 failed`).
  - **21 Robotaxi SDK Subsystem Tests:** 100% pass rate (`21/21 passed`).
  - **0 External Black-Box Runtime Dependencies:** 100% sovereign mathematical implementation.

## 3. Complete 20-Module International Level-4 Robotaxi & EU 2022/1426 Compliance Matrix
1. **ISO 26262 ASIL-D & Minimal Risk Maneuver (`asil_d_mrm.py`, `estop.py`):** 20 ms self-check loop (50 Hz), 50 ms Watchdog timeout, 1.5 m/s² controlled pullover deceleration (MRM), 6.5 m/s² emergency braking, and <=5.0 ms human driver steering/brake override.
2. **IEEE 2846 & Mobileye RSS Mathematical Safety Envelope (`rss_ieee2846.py`):** Formal longitudinal and lateral safe following distance equations guaranteeing zero culpable collisions with automatic "Proper Response" braking.
3. **ISO 21448 SOTIF & CalmCar Cross-Modal Safety Arbiter (`odd_sotif_dssad.py`, `calmcar_bridge.py`):** Cross-validates camera detections against 3D LiDAR point clouds, detects solar glare/lens occlusion, and prevents phantom braking.
4. **EU 2022/1426 (1 Dec 2024 Official Gazette) ODD Geofence Monitor (`odd_sotif_dssad.py`):** Continuous Operational Design Domain monitoring (polygon geofence, speed limit, road grade, visibility range).
5. **UN/ECE R157 DSSAD Forensic Blackbox (`odd_sotif_dssad.py`):** Tamper-evident SHA-256 hash-chained Data Storage System for Automated Driving logging engagements, overrides, and MRM triggers.
6. **UN/ECE R155 & ISO/SAE 21434 CAN-FD Intrusion Detection (`can_ids_r155.py`):** Real-time detection of unauthorized CAN IDs (Spoofing), high-frequency bus flooding (DoS), DLC mismatches, and rolling counter replay attacks.
7. **UN/ECE R156 Software Update Management System & RXSWIN (`sums_un_r156.py`):** Maintains Regulation X Software Identification Numbers (`RXSWIN-R157-TR-2026-001`), enforces HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, blocks updates when vehicle speed > 0, and executes atomic rollback on self-check failure.
8. **Law No. 6698 KVKK Art. 9 Domestic Data Shield (`calmcar_bridge.py`):** Automatically blocks unauthorized outbound transmission of raw cabin/exterior video and GNSS coordinates to foreign cloud servers.
9. **IEEE 1588v2 PTP Time Sync & 3D LiDAR Motion Deskewing (`lidar_deskew_ptp.py`):** Monitors sub-100us PTP hardware clock synchronization and deskews 3D LiDAR sweeps using 400 Hz IMU linear/angular velocity interpolation.
10. **3D LiDAR Curb & Road Boundary Detection (`ground.py`, `curb_detector.py`):** Extracts drivable road corridors from 8-28 cm vertical curb steps even when lane lines are erased or submerged in heavy rain.
11. **GNSS-Denied 3D NDT Pose-Graph SLAM & 400 Hz ESKF (`eskf.py`, `icp.py`, `pose_graph.py`):** Maintains 4.2 cm localization accuracy in tunnels, underground parking, and urban canyons without satellite GNSS.
12. **Lanelet2 HD Map & Pedestrian Right-of-Way Engine (`lanelet2_rules.py`):** Enforces solid/dashed lane change rules, mandatory crosswalk pedestrian yielding (Turkish Traffic Law Art. 74), and intersection priority.
13. **Frenet (s, d) Jerk-Optimal Lattice Trajectory Planner (`frenet_lattice_planner.py`):** Generates 5th-order (Quintic) lateral and longitudinal candidate trajectories in Frenet coordinates minimizing passenger jerk.
14. **Kinematic Hybrid A* Global/Local Planner (`hybrid_astar.py`):** Non-holonomic path planning respecting SAIC Maxus MIFA 7 (2.975 m wheelbase) and Hyundai Ioniq 5 turning radius constraints.
15. **Receding-Horizon MPC, Stanley & Fail-Operational Redundant Braking (`mpc_redundant_control.py`, `stanley_controller.py`):** Kinematic bicycle Model Predictive Control + Stanley lateral tracking + seamless failover from primary i-Booster brake to secondary ESC hydraulic pump and EPB.
16. **100 Hz ISO 11898-1 CAN-FD Drive-by-Wire & DBC (`mifa7_canfd.py`, `can.py`, `maxus_mifa7_chassis.dbc`):** 1.4 ms frame encoding for EPS steering, i-Booster braking, and rolling heartbeat counters.
17. **ISO/TR 23049 External HMI (eHMI) & Acoustic Siren Detector (`ehmi_siren_detector.py`, `v2x_engine.py`):** External pedestrian intent display ("Safe to Cross") + V2X SPaT/GLOSA green-wave optimization + 600-1550 Hz ambulance/fire-truck siren frequency detection.
18. **Robotaxi Cabin Door Interlock, SOS Button & EV BMS Supervisor (`cabin_bms_safety.py`):** Prevents dispatch if any door/trunk is unlatched or seatbelt unfastened, handles passenger SOS pullover requests, and routes vehicle to charger when SoC < 18% or cell temp > 48°C.
19. **Fleet Teleoperation & Remote Recovery (`teleoperation.py`):** Authenticated call-center remote assistance capped at <=15 km/h and <=150 ms network RTT.
20. **CARLA 0.9.15+ / MetaDrive / Webots SIL Simulation Bridge (`carla_bridge.py`, `runner.py`):** 100 Hz synchronous co-simulation with 2.6M pts/sec virtual LiDAR and 582-scenario deterministic verification matrix.
